description: This file defines the AimGuardrail class, a custom guardrail implementation for handling security and moderation checks on LLM calls using AIM security guardrails. It includes methods for pre-call hooks, moderation, output analysis, and streaming, with integration to AIM's API endpoints.

classes.name: AimGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class for integrating AIM security guardrails with LLM calls, handling pre-call, moderation, output analysis, and streaming.

classes.name: AimGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Exception raised when AIM API key secrets are missing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes AimGuardrail with API key, base URLs, and sets up the async HTTP client.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Performs pre-call guardrail analysis before LLM call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Performs moderation analysis during LLM call.

methods.name: call_aim_guardrail
methods.description: Sends data to AIM API for analysis and handles required actions.

methods.name: _handle_block_action
methods.description: Handles block actions by raising HTTPException.

methods.name: _anonymize_request
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from the request data.

methods.name: _handle_block_action_on_output
methods.description: Handles block actions based on output analysis.

methods.name: _build_aim_headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for AIM API requests.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-processing hook after successful call, potentially redacting output.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Handles streaming responses, forwarding to AIM for analysis.

methods.name: forward_the_stream_to_aim
methods.description: Sends response stream chunks to AIM via websocket.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for AIM guardrail.
